body:
﻿## Reproduction
Open Room plans and wait for an initial clear or blocked placement result. Close and reopen it while delaying the new worker preflight. The actual dialog immediately disables numeric Submit and clears the quote, but still displays the previous clear/blocked statement and old blocked-square marks while the current check is pending.

## Confirmed evidence
Focused DOM tests execute the actual createRoomTemplatePreview and RoomTemplateTool event listeners. Both initial clear and blocked cases fail against existing source (2 failures, 4 passes). Clearing obsolete status/marks at the start of refresh and marking the live status aria-busy makes all 6 cases green. Removing that production invalidation again gives both failures; restoring gives 6 green. TypeScript passes. Actual Full HD worker proof is prepared separately and not yet obtained.

## Distinction from #1934
#1934 handles late numeric placement result/catch callbacks overwriting a different card after its current result has arrived. This issue occurs before a current refresh result exists: the prior verdict remains visible during the new request despite existing revision guards.

## Scope
Withdraw prior status and tile/fixture overlays, set aria-busy while a real query is pending, retain disabled Submit. Invalid coordinates and rejected current queries finish busy state honestly. No new strings, save/command formats or camera policy. Fresh remote searches found #1934, #1646 (pending plan occupancy), and continuation records; none describes this pending visual state.

comments.body:
﻿Actual angled Full HD production artifact proof is complete. Active 112-square plan, Escape, prior Ready and Blocked reopen cycles use delayed real worker preflights. During pending: selected card preserved, aria-busy true, prior text and collision marks absent, Submit disabled, current catalogue quote retained. Actual reply restores the truthful verdict; final Escape restores Room plans focus, with no placement command sent.

Baseline: 1 passed, 7.7 s. Production mutation removing the invalidation block: 1 failed, 16.2 s (old Ready with aria-busy false). Restored artifact: 1 passed, 8.5 s. Original 60 s test / 10 s assertion budgets, one worker, zero retries unchanged. Eight actual-listener DOM cases pass, including current failure and invalid-coordinate exit from busy state.

Proof and opened screenshots: https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/tree/codex/room-plan-pending-reopen-20261002/docs/research/2026-10-02-room-plan-pending-reopen

title: Room-plan dialog keeps obsolete readiness and collision marks during a new preflight
